items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Beale and I swapped jobs

ctx.x: Chuck Beale was playing piano around Chicago, too, and Charlie Beale was playing with Jimmy Noone, and for some reason, Jimmy Noone and I swapped jobs, and I mean, Charlie Beale and I swapped jobs and it was okay with Jimmie and it was okay with Armstrong. So Charlie Beale went with Armstrong, and I went with Jimmie Noone; but Jimmie Noone was another one of my idols, too.
